The title and author sequence Yafei Shi, Yuxian Zheng, Yantao Wei, Xiang Ji, Ke Zhu match Crossref (message.title and message.author: https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1080%2F10400419.2026.2726242).

Crossref records online publication on 2026-09-07 in Creativity Research Journal, page range 1-18, and reference-count 97; these are bibliographic metadata, not participant or included-study counts (message.published-online, message.container-title, message.page, message.reference-count: https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1080%2F10400419.2026.2726242).

The source.version restriction to metadata only is appropriate: Crossref has no abstract field, OpenAlex abstract_inverted_index is null, Semantic Scholar abstract is null, and Europe PMC returns hitCount 0 (https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1080%2F10400419.2026.2726242; https://api.openalex.org/works/https://doi.org/10.1080/10400419.2026.2726242; https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/DOI:10.1080/10400419.2026.2726242?fields=title,authors,abstract,year,publicationDate,venue,journal,externalIds,isOpenAccess,openAccessPdf,url,publicationTypes; https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=DOI:10.1080%2F10400419.2026.2726242&format=json&resultType=core). No journal PDF, article text, or appendix was read.

Full text is not on file: retrieval.json, c115.status=not_obtained, with no md_path or pdf_path. Publisher /doi/full/ and /doi/abs/ pages and https://doi.org/10.1080/10400419.2026.2726242 returned HTTP 403 on 2026-10-09.

No open copy is supplied by the queried DOI records: OpenAlex open_access.oa_status=closed, best_oa_location=null and any_repository_has_fulltext=false; Semantic Scholar openAccessPdf.status=CLOSED with an empty URL (https://api.openalex.org/works/https://doi.org/10.1080/10400419.2026.2726242; https://api.semanticscholar.org/graph/v1/paper/DOI:10.1080/10400419.2026.2726242?fields=title,authors,abstract,year,publicationDate,venue,journal,externalIds,isOpenAccess,openAccessPdf,url,publicationTypes). The attempted arXiv title query returned HTTP 429, so it cannot rule out a preprint.

The null participant counts, null synthesis.k_studies and synthesis.n_effect_sizes, and empty synthesis.pooled should remain unfilled: none of the accessible metadata provides these quantities, intervals, search dates, or standardizers (Crossref, OpenAlex, and Semantic Scholar records cited above). The unverified candidate lead of 19 studies and g=0.908 was not promoted to a confirmed result.

There are no outcome reported strings to verify, and the one_line_finding appropriately gives no pooled numerical finding; the 2026 year is supported by Crossref message.published-online, while the inaccessible abstract/full text prevents a numerical check (https://api.crossref.org/works/10.1080%2F10400419.2026.2726242; publisher access attempts on 2026-10-09).

has_randomized_people_study=false records that no qualifying primary experiment was identified in the available sources. It does not certify absence from the unread paper; analyzed people counts and the fewer-than-50 threshold cannot be assessed (retrieval.json, c115; absent abstracts in the API records cited above).
summary: The accessible metadata support synthesis context, but the form makes unsupported claims about assignment structure and the absence of a primary experiment. No randomized people study was identified; without an abstract or full text, participant counts, study counts, pooled estimates, intervals, and standardizers remain unverified.
